meta.bit_reading_note: each position's label names its job; in the wait test (circuit W-no, W-ref; part W) c0 to c4 are the end lines' results (manacitra.wait.WAIT_TEST_ROUNDS) and c5 is M's; in the other circuits M is measured into the label's m_clbit and the other bits read 0. meta.description: Kickoff 57, the check at the peak phase on ibm_kingston, in two jobs. Four chains L1-M-L3 drawn at build by the rule's fixed procedure (chain_draw): 0-1-2, 90-89-88, 57-47-48 and 17-27-28. Job 1, the sweep: per chain, R1(phi), the active-neighbour Ramsey (manacitra.wait.build_wait_ramsey, its default), at phi in {0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300} degrees, one rz(phi) on M right after its first H; 24 circuits, each 2 copies of 2000 shots. From job 1's counts, each chain's peak phase phi* (peaks), recorded before job 2 was built. Job 2, the check: per chain, W-no(phi*), R1(phi*), W-ref (XY4) and Z for the verdict, each 2 copies of 3000 shots; beside it, R0(phi*), W-no(+90), R1(+90) and R0(+90), each 2 copies of 1500 shots; 32 circuits. Each job in one random order; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

built_from.how: the chains drawn once by hw_57.py (draw_chains) on the live target; the circuits by manacitra.wait at this commit, unedited: R1(phi) by build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, phase), W-no(phi) by build_wait_test(chain, False, backend, phase), W-ref by build_wait_test(chain, True, backend), R0(phi) by build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, neighbours="idle", phase); Z outside the package (Kickoff 50's, hw_50.py), translated by manacitra.wait.to_backend and scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled; against the live ibm_kingston target at each build (dt 4 ns)

T_M.definition: from the end of M's first H (its first sx) to the start of its last H (its last sx), in the wait test without refocusing (W-no) as scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled on the live target

fixed_before_the_data.rule: the revised rule at the peak phase: a cell is one chain at its phi*, informative if its loss_R1 interval lies entirely above informative_floor; DISAGREE if any informative cell's d1 interval lies entirely outside [-margin, +margin]; AGREE if every informative cell's lies entirely inside; NOT SETTLED otherwise; with no informative cell, the verdict carries ", uninformative". d1(phi*) = F_no(phi*) - F_ref (1 - loss_R1(phi*)), loss = M's P(1) minus its P(1) in Z, F against the wait test's phi = 0 parity ideal. phi* = 180 - theta_R1, wrapped to [0, 360) and rounded to the nearest whole degree, from job 1's fit (OLS of M's P(1) over the six phases, theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b)), recorded before job 2 was built
fixed_before_the_data.bootstraps: the verdict's: Kickoff 53's analysis (analyse_53.py, byte-identical) on the phi* circuits, W-ref and Z only, the phi* circuits labelled phase 0 for the call, seed bootstrap, n_boot draws, chain by chain in the drawn order: F for W-no(phi*) and W-ref (the copies with replacement, each redrawn from a multinomial), then P(1) for Z, R0(phi*), R1(phi*) (the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially). Beside the verdict, analyse_57.py's joint generator with the same seed: it first repeats the verdict's draws, which must equal them exactly, then continues: per M, W-no(+90), R0(+90), R1(+90); then job 1's R1 at the six phases per M (the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially), refitting on every resample

design.peak_procedure: analyse_57.peaks: OLS of M's P(1) over the six phases (analyse_52.fit, theta_R); theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b); phi* = 180 - theta_R1 wrapped to [0, 360), rounded to the nearest whole degree (halves up); from the point estimate

offline_build.what: the dry run before the go: the same circuits built for qiskit-ibm-runtime's offline ibm_kingston snapshot, whose durations differ from the live target's, so its T_M and timings differ; its own draw on the snapshot's published values, and job 2 built at the peaks from job 1's exact values and at stated peaks; not sent

draw_on_snapshot.procedure: k57-rule.md: candidates on the live target's CZ edges (either direction), L1 != L3; exclusions (a qubit of Kickoffs 55 and 56; operational; readout error above 3%; CZ error above 1%, the larger of the edge's listed directions; a missing value excludes); sort by (M, L1, L3); numpy.random.default_rng(5757).shuffle; take in order, skipping any chain that shares a qubit with one taken, until four

chain_draw.procedure: k57-rule.md: candidates on the live target's CZ edges (either direction), L1 != L3; exclusions (a qubit of Kickoffs 55 and 56; operational; readout error above 3%; CZ error above 1%, the larger of the edge's listed directions; a missing value excludes); sort by (M, L1, L3); numpy.random.default_rng(5757).shuffle; take in order, skipping any chain that shares a qubit with one taken, until four

peaks.rule: k57-rule.md: per chain, M's P(1) with the copies pooled; OLS fit c + b cos(phi) + s sin(phi) over the six phases; theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b); phi* = 180 - theta_R1, wrapped to [0, 360), rounded to the nearest whole degree; from the point estimate only
peaks.what: the peak phases, computed from job 1's counts by the rule's procedure and recorded at computed_utc, before job 2 was built (the job 2 records name this file by its SHA-256)

"""Kickoff 57 analysis, fixed before the data (sections 3 and 4 of the kickoff; k57-rule.md).

The peak phase (from job 1, before job 2 is built): per chain, M's P(1) from its own bit with the copies pooled at
phi = 0, 60, ..., 300; the OLS fit y = c + b cos(phi) + s sin(phi) (analyse_52.py's fit and theta_R, unchanged);
theta_R1 = atan2(s, -b); phi* = 180 - theta_R1, wrapped to [0, 360) and rounded to the nearest whole degree (halves up).
From the point estimate only.

The verdict (job 2): Kickoff 53 and 55's analysis on the four phi* cells, by analyse_53.py's analyse() unchanged (a
byte-identical copy), with its bootstrap seed set to 57 as k57-rule.md fixes it. analyse_53 is written for a list of
phases shared by every chain; here each chain has its own phi*, so the phi* circuits are passed to it labelled with phase
0 and its phase list is set to (0,) for the call: its cells "M|+0" are the phi* cells (F is still taken against the
phi = 0 parity ideal, as the rule fixes). Only the phi* circuits, W-ref and Z go to it. Its bootstrap draws the copies
with replacement and redraws each drawn copy's shots (Kickoff 52's method; the same functions as analyse_52.py's).

Beside the verdict, from one generator (seed 57, 10,000 draws): it first repeats analyse_53's draws for the verdict, in
its order (per M: W-no(phi*), W-ref; Z, R0(phi*), R1(phi*)), and the result must equal analyse_53's exactly; it then
continues, from the same generator:
  1. the check at +90 on the same chains: per M, W-no(+90), then R0(+90), R1(+90), with W-ref and Z from the draws above;
     d1(+90), informative by loss_R1, and the verdict analyse_53's rule gives on those cells;
  2. the original rule (R0): at phi* from analyse_53's own result, and at +90 from (1), with their verdicts;
  3. job 1's fits: per M, R1's P(1) at the six phases (copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially), refitting on
     every resample; theta_R1 (wrapped near its point estimate) and the amplitude with intervals; the residuals;
  4. the drift between the jobs: R1's P(1) at phi* in job 2 beside the P(1) job 1's fit gives at phi*; and as losses,
     both minus job 2's Z (job 1 has no Z).

H57: DISAGREE if any informative cell's d1 interval lies entirely outside [-0.15, +0.15]; AGREE if every informative
cell's lies entirely inside; NOT SETTLED otherwise; ", uninformative" if no cell is informative.

Usage: python analyse_57.py                 (Kickoff 57's files)
       python analyse_57.py --synthetic     (the peak procedure at stated theta 0, +40, -100; job 2 built to AGREE and
                                             to DISAGREE)"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "src-e45f15d" / "tests"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import analyse_52 as A52  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 52's fit functions, unchanged
import analyse_53 as A53  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 53's analysis, unchanged

A53.SEED = 57                      # the verdict's bootstrap seed (k57-rule.md)
SEED, N_BOOT = 57, 10_000
PHIS1 = A52.PHIS                   # 0, 60, ..., 300
W = A53.W
pct, wrap, near, fit, theta_R = A52.pct, A52.wrap, A52.near, A52.fit, A52.theta_R


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the peak phase
def peak_phase(theta_deg):
    """phi* = 180 - theta, wrapped to [0, 360), rounded to the nearest whole degree (halves up)."""
    x = (180.0 - float(theta_deg)) % 360.0
    return int(math.floor(x + 0.5)) % 360


def m_ones(lab, cts):
    i = lab["m_clbit"]
    return sum(n for k, n in cts.items() if k.replace(" ", "")[::-1][i] == "1"), sum(cts.values())


def job1_bits(labels, counts):
    bits = defaultdict(list)
    for lab, cts in zip(labels, counts):
        o, t = m_ones(lab, cts)
        bits[(str(lab["M"]), lab["phi_deg"])].append((lab["copy"], o, t))
    for k in bits:
        bits[k].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    return bits


def peaks(labels, counts, order):
    """The rule's peak procedure on job 1, from the point estimate; recorded before job 2 is built."""
    bits = job1_bits(labels, counts)
    out = {}
    for M in order:
        y = np.array([sum(x[1] for x in bits[(M, p)]) / sum(x[2] for x in bits[(M, p)]) for p in PHIS1])
        c, b, s = (float(v) for v in fit(y))
        th = float(theta_R(y))
        out[M] = {"P1": dict(zip(map(str, PHIS1), y.tolist())), "c": c, "b": b, "s": s, "theta_R1_deg": th, "amplitude": math.hypot(b, s),
                  "residuals": (y - A52._X @ np.array([c, b, s])).tolist(), "phi_star_unrounded_deg": (180.0 - th) % 360.0,
                  "phi_star_deg": peak_phase(th)}
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the verdict, by analyse_53 unchanged
def verdict_by_a53(labels2, counts2, order):
    sel, lab0 = [], []
    for lab, cts in zip(labels2, counts2):
        if lab["role"] == "peak" or lab["circuit"] in ("W-ref", "Z"):
            l = dict(lab)
            l["phi_deg"] = 0
            lab0.append(l)
            sel.append(cts)
    saved = A53.PHIS
    A53.PHIS = (0,)
    try:
        r = A53.analyse(lab0, sel, order)
    finally:
        A53.PHIS = saved
    return r


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the joint generator, beside the verdict
def analyse(labels1, counts1, labels2, counts2, order, phistar):
    r53 = verdict_by_a53(labels2, counts2, order)
    keys, q = A53.reuse._wait_test_keys()

    def F(V):
        return np.sqrt(V / V.sum(-1, keepdims=True) * q).sum(-1) ** 2

    cells, bits, pooled = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list), defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    for lab, cts in zip(labels2, counts2):
        key = (str(lab["M"]), lab["circuit"], lab["role"])
        if lab["part"] == "W":
            d = defaultdict(int)
            for k, n in cts.items():
                kk = k.replace(" ", "")[-W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS:]
                d[kk] += n
                pooled[key][kk] += n
            cells[key].append((lab["copy"], [d.get(k, 0) for k in keys]))
        else:
            o, t = m_ones(lab, cts)
            bits[key].append((lab["copy"], o, t))
    for (M, p), v in job1_bits(labels1, counts1).items():
        bits[(M, "R1-sweep", p)] = v
    for dd in (cells, bits):
        for k in dd:
            dd[k].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

    def draw_F(key):
        V = np.array([x[1] for x in cells[key]], float)
        freq = V / V.sum(1, keepdims=True)
        idx = rng.integers(0, V.shape[0], size=(N_BOOT, V.shape[0]))
        return F(rng.multinomial(int(V[0].sum()), freq[idx]).sum(1))

    def draw_P(key):
        o = np.array([x[1] for x in bits[key]])
        t = np.array([x[2] for x in bits[key]])
        acc1, accn = np.zeros(N_BOOT), np.zeros(N_BOOT)
        for _ in range(len(o)):
            pick = rng.integers(0, len(o), size=N_BOOT)
            acc1 += rng.binomial(t[pick], o[pick] / t[pick])
            accn += t[pick]
        return acc1 / accn

    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    P = {k: sum(x[1] for x in v) / sum(x[2] for x in v) for k, v in bits.items()}
    Fp = {k: W.fidelity(dict(v), ideal) for k, v in pooled.items()}
    Fb, Pb = {}, {}
    # the verdict's draws, in analyse_53's order
    for M in order:
        for k in ((M, "W-no", "peak"), (M, "W-ref", "ref")):
            Fb[k] = draw_F(k)
        for k in ((M, "Z", "zero"), (M, "R0", "peak"), (M, "R1", "peak")):
            Pb[k] = draw_P(k)
    replay = {}
    for M in order:
        z, zb, fr, frb = P[(M, "Z", "zero")], Pb[(M, "Z", "zero")], Fp[(M, "W-ref", "ref")], Fb[(M, "W-ref", "ref")]
        l1, l1b = P[(M, "R1", "peak")] - z, Pb[(M, "R1", "peak")] - zb
        replay[M] = {"d1": Fp[(M, "W-no", "peak")] - fr * (1 - l1), "d1_ci90": pct(Fb[(M, "W-no", "peak")] - frb * (1 - l1b))}
    c53 = {c["M"]: c for c in r53["cells"]}
    same = all(abs(replay[M]["d1"] - c53[M]["d1"]) < 1e-12 and np.allclose(replay[M]["d1_ci90"], c53[M]["d1_ci90"], rtol=0, atol=1e-12) for M in order)
    if not same:
        raise RuntimeError("the joint generator does not repeat analyse_53's verdict draws")
    # 1 and 2: the check at +90 on the same chains, with the original rule there
    for M in order:
        Fb[(M, "W-no", "plus90")] = draw_F((M, "W-no", "plus90"))
        for k in ((M, "R0", "plus90"), (M, "R1", "plus90")):
            Pb[k] = draw_P(k)
    p90 = []
    for M in order:
        z, zb, fr, frb = P[(M, "Z", "zero")], Pb[(M, "Z", "zero")], Fp[(M, "W-ref", "ref")], Fb[(M, "W-ref", "ref")]
        fno, fnob = Fp[(M, "W-no", "plus90")], Fb[(M, "W-no", "plus90")]
        l0, l0b = P[(M, "R0", "plus90")] - z, Pb[(M, "R0", "plus90")] - zb
        l1, l1b = P[(M, "R1", "plus90")] - z, Pb[(M, "R1", "plus90")] - zb
        c = {"cell": f"{M}|+90", "M": M, "phi_deg": 90, "F_no": fno, "F_no_ci90": pct(fnob), "F_ref": fr,
             "loss_R0": l0, "loss_R0_ci90": pct(l0b), "loss_R1": l1, "loss_R1_ci90": pct(l1b),
             "d1": fno - fr * (1 - l1), "d1_ci90": pct(fnob - frb * (1 - l1b)), "d0": fno - fr * (1 - l0), "d0_ci90": pct(fnob - frb * (1 - l0b))}
        c["informative_R1"] = c["loss_R1_ci90"][0] > A53.FLOOR
        c["informative_R0"] = c["loss_R0_ci90"][0] > A53.FLOOR
        p90.append(c)
    v90, inf90 = A53.rule(p90, "d1", "loss_R1")
    v90_0, inf90_0 = A53.rule(p90, "d0", "loss_R0")
    # 3: job 1's fits
    fits1 = {}
    for M in order:
        ks = [(M, "R1-sweep", p) for p in PHIS1]
        for k in ks:
            Pb[k] = draw_P(k)
        y = np.array([P[k] for k in ks])
        yb = np.stack([Pb[k] for k in ks], -1)
        c0, b, s = (float(v) for v in fit(y))
        _, bb, sb = fit(yb)
        th, thb = float(theta_R(y)), theta_R(yb)
        fits1[M] = {"theta_R1_deg": th, "theta_ci90": pct(near(thb, th)), "amplitude": math.hypot(b, s), "amplitude_ci90": pct(np.hypot(bb, sb)),
                    "c": c0, "b": b, "s": s, "residuals": (y - A52._X @ np.array([c0, b, s])).tolist(), "P1": dict(zip(map(str, PHIS1), y.tolist())),
                    "phi_star_from_this_fit": peak_phase(th)}
    # 4: the drift between the jobs
    drift = {}
    for M in order:
        ph = math.radians(phistar[M])
        f = fits1[M]
        p1_fit = f["c"] + f["b"] * math.cos(ph) + f["s"] * math.sin(ph)
        p1_j2 = P[(M, "R1", "peak")]
        z = P[(M, "Z", "zero")]
        drift[M] = {"phi_star_deg": phistar[M], "R1_P1_job2": p1_j2, "R1_P1_job1_fit_at_phi_star": p1_fit, "difference_P1": p1_j2 - p1_fit,
                    "R1_loss_job2": p1_j2 - z, "R1_loss_job1_fit_minus_job2_Z": p1_fit - z, "job1_fit_maximum_P1": f["c"] + f["amplitude"]}
    d1 = [c["d1"] for c in r53["cells"]]
    return {"H57": r53["H53"], "informative_cells": r53["informative_cells"], "cells_phi_star": r53["cells"], "chains": r53["chains"],
            "phi_star_deg": phistar, "original_rule_at_phi_star": {"verdict": r53["beside"]["original_rule_verdict"], "informative": r53["beside"]["original_rule_informative_cells"]},
            "comparison_at_phi_star": r53["beside"],
            "check_at_plus90": {"cells": p90, "verdict": v90, "informative_cells": inf90, "original_rule_verdict": v90_0, "original_rule_informative_cells": inf90_0},
            "lean_phi_star": {"d1": {c["M"]: c["d1"] for c in r53["cells"]}, "mean_d1": float(np.mean(d1)), "n_d1_above_zero": int(sum(x > 0 for x in d1))},
            "job1_fits": fits1, "drift": drift, "joint_generator_repeats_analyse_53": same}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- synthetic counts
def synthetic():
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    ik = sorted(ideal)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)

    def w_counts(f, n):
        p = {k: f / 32 for k in ik}
        p["000001"] = 1 - f
        ks = list(p)
        x = rng.multinomial(n, [p[k] for k in ks])
        return {k: int(v) for k, v in zip(ks, x) if v}

    def r_counts(p1, n, bits=6):
        o = int(rng.binomial(n, min(max(p1, 0.0), 1.0)))
        if bits == 1:
            return {"0": n - o, "1": o}
        return {"0" * bits: n - o, "1" + "0" * (bits - 1): o}

    s2 = lambda x: math.sin(math.radians(x) / 2) ** 2
    ok = True
    # the peak procedure at stated theta
    order = ["11", "22", "33"]
    th = {"11": 0, "22": 40, "33": -100}
    want = {"11": 180, "22": 140, "33": 280}
    l1, c1 = [], []
    for M in order:
        for cp in (1, 2):
            for p in PHIS1:
                l1.append({"job": 1, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": "sweep", "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "S"})
                c1.append(r_counts(0.02 + 0.9 * s2(p + th[M]), 2000))
    pk = peaks(l1, c1, order)
    got = {M: pk[M]["phi_star_deg"] for M in order}
    good = all(abs(got[M] - want[M]) <= 2 for M in order)
    ok = ok and good
    print(f"peak procedure on synthetic counts with draw noise (2 copies x 2,000 shots): stated theta {th}; phi* {got}, expected {want} within 2 degrees (shot noise moves the fit); "
          f"fitted theta { {M: round(pk[M]['theta_R1_deg'], 2) for M in order} } | {'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'}")
    exact = {M: peak_phase(float(theta_R(np.array([s2(p + th[M]) for p in PHIS1])))) for M in order}
    good = exact == want
    ok = ok and good
    print(f"peak procedure on exact values: phi* {exact} | {'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'}")
    le, ce = [], []
    for M in order:
        for cp in (1, 2):
            for p in PHIS1:
                o = int(round(2000 * (0.02 + 0.9 * s2(p + th[M]))))
                le.append({"job": 1, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": "sweep", "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "S"})
                ce.append({"000000": 2000 - o, "100000": o})
    pke = peaks(le, ce, order)
    got = {M: pke[M]["phi_star_deg"] for M in order}
    good = got == want
    ok = ok and good
    print(f"peak procedure on synthetic counts at their expected values (2 copies x 2,000 shots, no draw noise): phi* {got}, expected {want}; "
          f"fitted theta { {M: round(pke[M]['theta_R1_deg'], 3) for M in order} } | {'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'}")
    # job 2 built to AGREE and to DISAGREE: F_no = 0.9 (1 - 0.9 sin^2((phi + theta_W)/2)), R1 loss 0.9 sin^2((phi + theta_R)/2)
    order = ["11", "22", "33", "44"]
    thR = {"11": 10, "22": -40, "33": 100, "44": -150}
    for name, extra in (("AGREE", {}), ("DISAGREE", {"33": 90})):
        l1, c1, l2, c2 = [], [], [], []
        for M in order:
            for cp in (1, 2):
                for p in PHIS1:
                    l1.append({"job": 1, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": "sweep", "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "S"})
                    c1.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M]), 2000))
        ps = {M: v["phi_star_deg"] for M, v in peaks(l1, c1, order).items()}
        for M in order:
            tW = thR[M] + extra.get(M, 0)
            for cp in (1, 2):
                for role, p, n in (("peak", ps[M], 3000), ("plus90", 90, 1500)):
                    l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "W-no", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "part": "W"})
                    c2.append(w_counts(0.9 * (1 - 0.9 * s2(p + tW)), n))
                    l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "R"})
                    c2.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M]), n))
                    l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R0", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 0, "part": "R"})
                    c2.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M] + 20), 1500, bits=1))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "W-ref", "role": "ref", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "part": "W"})
                c2.append(w_counts(0.9, 3000))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "Z", "role": "zero", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "R"})
                c2.append(r_counts(0.01, 3000))
        r = analyse(l1, c1, l2, c2, order, ps)
        good = r["H57"].startswith(name) and r["joint_generator_repeats_analyse_53"]
        fit_ok = all(abs(wrap(r["job1_fits"][M]["theta_R1_deg"] - thR[M])) < 3 for M in order)
        ok = ok and good and fit_ok
        print(f"job 2 built to {name}: got {r['H57']} | phi* {ps} | informative {r['informative_cells']} | d1 "
              f"{ {c['M']: (round(c['d1'], 3), [round(x, 3) for x in c['d1_ci90']]) for c in r['cells_phi_star']} } | at +90 {r['check_at_plus90']['verdict']} | "
              f"job 1 fits {'recover' if fit_ok else 'MISS'} the stated theta | joint generator repeats analyse_53 {r['joint_generator_repeats_analyse_53']} | "
              f"{'PASS' if good and fit_ok else 'FAIL'}")
    print("synthetic overall:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return ok
